svg.title: KvCacheManager calls step by step
svg.text: KvCacheManager: Kenji's page table, 16 positions a page
A pool of 26 pages here (about 1,450 in the game). Mei's conversation was released; her 22 full pages stay cached.
AttachPrefix(sequence, tokens): pages = Match(tokens, max_pages), max_pages = (tokens.size() − 1) / page_size
Kenji 361 tokens: max_pages = 360 / 16 = 22 (coral); Match stops at page 20, the first that differs from Mei's
length 320; 41 to compute
Mei's first 352 tokens: max_pages = 351 / 16 = 21 (coral); every page is cached, but page 21 holds the last token
length 336; 16 to compute
kenji.pages and kenji.length at each call
free_
Reserve(kenji, 361) → true
Allocate() one page at a time; length is not changed
length 320
kenji.length = 361
the caller, after the forward pass has written those positions
length 361
Reserve(kenji, 369) → true
decoding: this position needs a new page, the last free one
length 368
Reserve(kenji, 385) → true
free_ is empty: EvictOne() frees cached page 20; Allocate() takes it
length 384
Reserve(kenji, 425) → false
the next message, 33 positions, needs 2 more pages
length 392
EvictOne() frees page 21 and Allocate() takes it; for the second page no cached page has 1 owner left, so Release(21) and return false.
Teal: shared pages from the prefix cache; purple: Kenji's own; filled part: positions below length; amber: changed by that row.
lines 88–90
AttachPrefix: at most (size − 1) / page_size pages from Match (dashed coral line); length = their positions
lines 33–45
Reserve: Allocate; if the pool is empty, EvictOne and Allocate once more
lines 39–43
still no page: release every page this call added, return false
line 229
engine.cpp: the caller advances length after the forward pass
